name: Somogyapáti (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of dark blue over dark red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Somogyapáti (a dark red shield with a yellow lion and ears of grain, with yellow mantling) below the name SOMOGYAPÁTI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
